opis: A happy PICNIC on the sunny glade from the reference picture: the ROE DEER, the FOX and the SQUIRREL sit together on the red-and-white checked blanket under the big oak, the wicker basket open beside them. The FOX holds up ONE very LONG baguette of bread and is breaking it into pieces; the SQUIRREL already nibbles her piece, the DEER takes hers; a jug of juice and three cups. The squirrel wears a long blue-and-white striped scarf. Behind them a narrow footpath comes almost straight across the meadow to the blanket. Warm summer light, everybody smiling.
